title: UCP Capability Negotiation
description: Intersects the UCP capability sets two pasted profiles advertise: keeps the capabilities named by both sides at their highest mutually supported dated version, applies each extension's requires bounds, prunes extensions whose parents did not survive, and reports profile-shape findings (canonical keys[] placement, namespace authority binding against the reversed schema host, dev.ucp.* release pinning, protocol version format). Verify-only: decides from the two pasted profile objects and never fetches profiles, leaf documents, or schemas.

business_profile.description: A UCP profile object: required ucp member with ucp.version (YYYY-MM-DD), ucp.services, ucp.payment_handlers; optional ucp.capabilities and ucp.supported_versions.

platform_profile.description: A UCP profile object with the same required members.

mcp_tool_definition.name: negotiate_ucp_capabilities
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compute the UCP capability set two pasted profiles agree on: intersect by name, select the highest mutual dated version per capability (supported_versions included), apply extension requires bounds, prune orphaned extensions to a fixpoint, and report profile-shape findings. Verify-only - never fetches.
